originalTitle: Netflix woes setting up for a Hollywood ending, says trader Mike Khouw
summary: Netflix's stock price may have lost the plot, but its fundamental narrative remains intact.
content:
Netflix's stock price may have lost the plot, but its fundamental narrative remains intact. Trading at 18.9x forward earnings — down near its 2022 bear-market trough (<15x) — the stock has gotten cheaper while the underlying business has gotten better.

Paying 18.9x for today's higher-margin, cash-generative Netflix is only four turns above the worst moment in its public history. That makes selling volatility far more attractive than buying shares outright.

The Trade: August 65/78/88 "Covered Strangle"

With Netflix around $70 and 25 calendar days to August expiration:
chineseTitle: 交易员迈克·库乌 (Mike Khouw) 表示，Netflix 在为好莱坞结局做好准备时遇到了麻烦
chineseSummary: Netflix的股价可能已经失去了情节，但其基本面仍然完好无损。
chineseContent:
Netflix的股价可能已经失去了情节，但其基本面仍然完好无损。该股的预期市盈率为 18.9 倍——低于 2022 年熊市低谷（<15 倍）——股价变得更便宜，而基础业务却变得更好。

以 18.9 倍的价格购买如今利润率更高、现金产出更高的 Netflix，仅比其公开历史上最糟糕时刻高出四倍。这使得出售波动性股票比直接购买股票更具吸引力。
